name: paperless-ngx
title: Paperless-ngx
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：qpdf 12.4.2 自编以支持 pikepdf；AI 功能关闭；未装 unpaper。

缺失功能：无 AI 分类/实体识别；无 unpaper 后处理。

额外依赖：需 Redis + celery worker/beat/consumer；8000。

镜像说明：3.3.2；qpdf 12.4.2 自编（pikepdf 10.17 要求）；tesseract eng/chi_sim/osd；AI 关闭、unpaper 无；单容器含 redis/celery worker/beat/consumer；8000
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: qpdf 12.4.2 is built for pikepdf; AI features are disabled; unpaper is not installed.

Missing features: No AI classification/entity extraction; no unpaper post-processing.

Extra dependencies: Requires Redis and celery worker/beat/consumer; port 8000.

Image notes: 3.3.2；qpdf 12.4.2 自编（pikepdf 10.17 要求）；tesseract eng/chi_sim/osd；AI 关闭、unpaper 无；单容器含 redis/celery worker/beat/consumer；8000

notes: 单容器内含 redis/celery worker/beat/consumer；SQLite 默认；/data 持久化。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
